The Flamix: Bitrix24 and WooCommerce Products Sync WordPress plugin before 1.7.0 does not restrict or validate an unauthenticated file-exchange request, allowing anyone to write a file with an attacker-chosen name, extension and path to a web-served location and thereby execute arbitrary PHP.

The Probono Form Basic WordPress plugin before 1.3.3 does not validate the real type of files uploaded through its public form, trusting the client-declared MIME type instead, which could allow unauthenticated attackers to upload PHP files to a public directory and execute them before they are deleted, on servers that do not honour the Probono Form Basic WordPress plugin before 1.3.3's Apache-only access restriction.

In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1 through 2.1.2, a listener configured with `protocol websockets` mishandles empty WebSocket data frames. `net__read_ws()` in `lib/net_ws.c` returns the number of framing bytes consumed (the 4 masking-key bytes) for a data frame with a zero-length payload, without writing any bytes to the caller’s buffer. The MQTT packet reader in `packet__read_single()` (`lib/packet_mosq.c`) trusts that return value as a payload byte count. A remote client can therefore advance the read position over an uninitialised heap allocation, causing the broker to process and forward uninitialised heap memory (information disclosure, including heap and libc pointers), and can underflow the unsigned `to_process` counter so that subsequent attacker-controlled frame data is written past the end of the allocation (heap out-of-bounds write). The out-of-bounds write is reachable from the CONNECT packet before any authentication check, so an unauthenticated client can corrupt the heap and crash the broker even when `allow_anonymous false` is set. Combining the disclosure and the write allows remote code execution as the broker’s user by any client able to establish a session.

Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains an incomplete blocklist fix that allows attackers who can author entry type title formats to write arbitrary files using ZipArchive or XMLWriter classes. Attackers can abuse the non-sandboxed renderObjectTemplate() renderer to write attacker-controlled content into the web docroot, achieving remote code execution.

Craft CMS from 5.0.0 before 5.11.4 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in ImageTransforms::normalizeTransform() that allows attackers to instantiate arbitrary classes by supplying class:null with a __class key. Attackers can reach the method through Craft Commerce's payments/pay redirect template calling customer.photo.getUrl() with a crafted transform to instantiate classes like yii\rbac\PhpManager and execute PHP.

SiYuan from 3.3.0 before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject HTML via unescaped checkbox column names in Gallery and Kanban AttributeView renderers. Attackers can share a crafted .sy.zip document whose rendering in the Electron desktop client with nodeIntegration enabled executes Node.js and host OS commands.

SiYuan before 3.8.10 persists a table block's caption attribute into IAL properties without HTML sanitization, causing stored cross-site scripting upon import or sync. Attackers can inject an entity-encoded caption with an onerror handler that executes in the Electron client's nodeIntegration context to achieve remote code execution.

NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated Creators to access another tenant's external database by reusing a victim source id when adding a source. Because NcConnectionMgrv2 caches connections by bare source id, attackers can reflect the victim's cached database schema and read, update, and insert records through their own base models.

Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows publishers to overwrite pages their per-page permissions deny by abusing FolderStorage key delimiter collisions and PageStorage folder reconstruction. Attackers can rename a folder like locked*** or save from a page with an unusual prefix width through a front-end Flex pages form, replacing protected content and permissions to access the protected subtree.

Grav from 2.0.0 before 2.2.18 contains a Twig injection vulnerability that allows media-only accounts and anonymous uploaders to execute Twig by placing delimiters in image titles, alt text, class, id, or file names. Attackers can combine injected Twig with the autoescape tag to serve script to every page visitor, including super admins, or expose unpublished page content.

The Unzer Payments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 2.2.1. The vulnerability exists because the Google Pay Express Checkout endpoint (`/?wc-api=google_pay_express`), handled by `startCheckoutDataWithNormalizedCustomerData`, accepts an attacker-controlled `paymentData.email` value and passes it to `createOrGetGuestCustomer()`, which resolves the submitted email to any existing WordPress user via `get_user_by('email', ...)` and then calls `wp_set_current_user()` and `wp_set_auth_cookie()` for the resolved user ID without verifying ownership of the email address, a password, a nonce, an authentication token, or any proof of payment from the payment provider. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to log in as any existing WordPress user — including administrators — by submitting that user's known email address, receiving valid `wordpress_logged_in_*` session cookies for the targeted account and achieving full site takeover. The endpoint is entirely unprotected with no capability check, nonce validation, or payment-provider signature verification applied, and administrator email addresses are frequently discoverable via the WordPress REST API user enumeration endpoint (`/wp-json/wp/v2/users`), author archive pages, Gravatar lookups, or site contact footers.

The Trust Payments Gateway for WooCommerce (JavaScript Library) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.8. The vulnerability exists because the `new_customer_account()` function stores the raw return value of `wp_create_user()` — including a `WP_Error` object returned on username collision — into the order's `tp_userid` post meta before the `is_wp_error()` guard is evaluated; the `add_customer_details_to_thankyou_page()` callback subsequently reads that meta and casts it with `(int)`, causing PHP to coerce any object to integer `1`, after which `wp_set_current_user(1)` and `wp_set_auth_cookie(1)` are called unconditionally. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to authenticate as WordPress user ID 1 — the bootstrap site administrator or, on multisite, a network super-admin — by supplying the `new_username` parameter matching any existing login during checkout and visiting the resulting thank-you page. Exploitation requires the Trust Payments gateway to be active and the attacker to complete a paid order on their own account; the ID 1 administrator username is additionally enumerable via standard WordPress user enumeration techniques.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an out-of-bounds memory vulnerability in the NAS NFS service that an unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit to cause a denial of service.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker with internal network access to execute arbitrary commands as root on the NAS node.

ThinkPHP 2.0 through 2.2 and 3.0 Lite mode contains an eval injection vulnerability in the Dispatcher PATH_INFO parsing, which uses preg_replace with the /e modifier and a double-quoted replacement. Unauthenticated attackers can send crafted requests to index.php with a malicious 's' parameter containing PHP expressions to execute arbitrary code on the server. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

Baidu UEditor 1.4.0 through 1.4.3.3 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the catchimage action of /ueditor/net/controller.ashx that only validates the Content-Type header. Unauthenticated attackers can supply a source[] URL like x.jpg?.aspx to retain a malicious extension and write an executable .aspx file for remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-17.

ThinkPHP 5.0.0 before 5.0.24 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute commands by setting _method=__construct in POST data to overwrite the Request filter property. Attackers can send POST requests to endpoints reached via ?s=captcha or ?s=index/index/index with filter[]=system and server[REQUEST_METHOD] values to execute arbitrary system commands. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

Weaver E-cology 9.0 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in /page/exportImport/uploadOperation.jsp that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary JSP files. Attackers can send a crafted multipart POST request with a JSP webshell written to /page/exportImport/fileTransfer/ to achieve remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-20.

OpenSNS 3.2.1 contains an unauthenticated code injection vulnerability in the shareBox method of ShareController that allows attackers to invoke arbitrary model methods via the query parameter. Attackers can send crafted GET requests to /index.php?s=weibo/Share/shareBox abusing parse_str and ShareModel::getInfo to reach Schedule::runSchedule and execute code through assert. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

MeterSphere versions 1.13.0 before 1.14.7 and 1.15.0 before 1.16.4 contain a pre-authentication code injection vulnerability due to the /plugin/** endpoints being exposed with anonymous access. Attackers can upload a malicious jar via POST /plugin/add and invoke it through POST /plugin/customMethod using the 'entry' and 'request' parameters, which are passed to Class.forName and method invocation for remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

nginxWebUI 3.0.0 before 3.5.8 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach the /AdminPage/conf/runCmd endpoint by using a case-variant path that evades the case-sensitive /adminPage/ login filter. Attackers can pass OS commands through the cmd parameter, which are executed via /bin/sh with insufficient filtering of & and $() characters, achieving remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

iDocView before 13.10.1_20231115 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the /html/2word endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files by supplying a malicious url parameter. Attackers can send a crafted GET request with the url parameter to download linked resources with an unsanitized path and unblocked .jsp extension, achieving remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-11-22.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains a stack-based buffer overflow in the NAS TFTP service that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause a denial of service or potential code execution.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker with internal network access to execute arbitrary commands as root on the NAS node.

Description:

When an iRule that processes client traffic using the GENERICMESSAGE::route command is configured on a virtual server, undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate and may lead to remote code execution (RCE). 





Impact:



Traffic is disrupted while the TMM process restarts. This vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the BIG-IP system and may allow the attacker to perform RCE. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.







Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

In addition, the attacker may be able to perform RCE. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.







Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

Description:

When an iRule that processes client traffic using the PEM::subscriber command is configured on a virtual server, undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate and may lead to remote code execution (RCE). 





Impact:



Traffic is disrupted while the TMM process restarts. This vulnerability allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the BIG-IP system and may perform RCE. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.







Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

When BIG-IP APM is provisioned and a per-request policy that includes the Client Information agent and Endpoint Security agents is applied to a virtual server, undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate and may lead to remote code execution (RCE).

Impact:

Traffic is disrupted while the TMM process restarts. This vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the BIG-IP system and may allow the attacker to perform RCE. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.

Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

The Masteriyo LMS – LMS Course Builder, Quizzes & Certificates plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in versions up to, and including, 3.5.1 via deserialization of untrusted input in the course importer. The set_post_metas() method  calls maybe_unserialize() on attacker-controlled postmeta string values parsed from the uploaded JSON import file. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary PHP Objects. Exploitation by unauthenticated attackers requires that the site has enable_instructor_registration=true AND enable_guest_checkout=true AND at least one purchasable course exists. Install.php sets enable_instructor_registration=false on fresh installs, so this is a non-default configuration. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with author-level access and above.

Dagu 1.23.0 before 2.0.0 defaults auth.mode to none, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute OS commands through the /api/v2/dag-runs endpoint. Attackers can send a POST request with an inline spec defining steps containing arbitrary shell commands to achieve remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-03-11.

ArangoDB before 3.12.11 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability caused by a parser differential between the raw path authentication gate and the URL-decoded dispatch logic. Attackers can send requests with a %5f-encoded leading underscore to endpoints like /_db/_system/%5fapi/simple/first-example to reach /_api/* actions as superuser without authentication. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-09-16.

Dialoqbase is an application for creating chatbots. Prior to 1.11.5, the unauthenticated GET /api/v1/view/* route in server/src/routes/api/v1/view/root.ts resolves its attacker-controlled wildcard path without normalization or containment, allowing traversal outside the intended uploads directory and arbitrary server file reads. Reading environment files can disclose DB_SECRET_KEY, the application’s JWT signing key, which permits forged administrator tokens and takeover of bots, conversations, integrations, and stored third-party credentials. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.5.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the storage-processor interconnect driver that could allow a malicious peer to execute code with system privileges.

All versions of LaraDashboard contain an authentication bypass in SocialAuthService::findOrCreateUser(), which links a social login to an existing account by email without checking that the OAuth provider verified that email. Unauthenticated attackers using an OAuth/OIDC provider that asserts a victim's email can log in as any user, including Superadmin, and keep persistent access through a linked social_accounts entry.

pnpm exe before 10.34.8 embeds an outdated Node.js runtime that still trusts compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates during registry TLS connections. Network attackers holding a recovered intermediate key can intercept standalone pnpm registry fetches and serve forged package metadata or tarballs.

Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows users permitted to import custom volumes to store unvalidated snapshot names from the backup index configuration section. Attackers can craft a backup with traversal sequences in snapshot names so later deletion removes arbitrary host directories as root, while renaming or mounting operates on arbitrary paths.

Incus before 7.6.0 exposes certificate and cluster join token secrets through the default project event stream and skips authorization when cancelling operations without associated permissions. Restricted clients can subscribe to operation events to capture certificate tokens and enroll unrestricted certificates, gaining full server access, or cancel token operations by UUID.

Wavelog is web-based amateur radio logging software. Prior to 2.5, the filename parameter accepted by POST /qsl/addQsoToQsl in application/controllers/Qsl.php addQsoToQsl() is stored without rejecting directory separators or relative path components, and POST /qsl/delete reaches application/models/Qsl_model.php deleteQsl(), which passes the planted qsl_images filename to unlink(). A standard authenticated user can associate the malicious filename with the user's own QSO, satisfy the ownership check, escape the per-user QSL image directory, and delete files writable by the PHP worker. Deleting configuration or operational files can cause denial of service, while deleting installer gate files can reopen the unauthenticated installer and enable application identity takeover through attacker-controlled database configuration. This issue is fixed in version 2.5.

AnsibleForms is a self-hosted web application that turns automation into self-service forms. Prior to 6.2.1, AnsibleForms uses a public hard-coded fallback JWT signing secret from server/config/auth.config.js when ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET is unset. An unauthenticated attacker can sign a self-contained token with privileged claims because server/src/auth/auth_jwt.js verifies the signature without reloading the user from the database, and server/src/lib/middleware.js trusts the token's roles and options for authorization. A forged token can therefore be accepted as an administrator session, resulting in authentication bypass and full privileged API access. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.1.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Emraan Cheema ListingPro listingpro-plugin allows SQL Injection.This issue affects ListingPro: from n/a through 2.9.4.

This issue was addressed with improved input validation. This issue is fixed in iOS 18.7.10 and iPadOS 18.7.10, iOS 26.5.2 and iPadOS 26.5.2, macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, macOS Sonoma 14.8.8, macOS Tahoe 26.5.2, tvOS 26.6, visionOS 26.6, watchOS 26.6. An app may be able to cause unexpected system termination or corrupt kernel memory.

A flaw was found in submariner. In cert-auth mode, the connection configuration is built using free-form strings from the Custom Resource Definition (CRD) without proper validation. A malicious cluster can exploit this by publishing a CableName that includes newlines and ipsec.conf directives. This allows an attacker to inject arbitrary configuration parameters or execute commands through leftupdown hooks, leading to remote code execution as root on the gateway node.

Open Access Management (OpenAM) is an access management solution. Prior to 16.1.1, MSISDNValidation in the MSISDN authentication module concatenates the request-supplied MSISDN value into an LDAP search filter without escaping, while the default empty trusted-gateway list allows all traffic. In a realm where an MSISDN module is enabled in a reachable authentication chain, an unauthenticated remote attacker can inject LDAP filter metacharacters, select an arbitrary matching user, and obtain a normal authenticated OpenAM session without a password. This issue is fixed in version 16.1.1.

Lantronix SLC8000/SLC9000 before firmware v9.7.0.2, EMG8500/EMG7500 before firmware v9.7.0.1, and all firmware versions of SLB882/SLCx-03/SLCx-02 contain a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with the services permission to execute arbitrary shell commands as root by exploiting the set cifs password command that passes unsanitized user input to a system() call. Attackers with the services permission can authenticate to the terminal or CLI interface and inject malicious commands through the unsanitized parameter to achieve complete loss of confidentiality, integrity, and availability on the affected device and potentially impact downstream serial-attached devices.

Lantronix SLC8000 before firmware v9.7.0.3, SLC9000 before firmware v9.7.0.2, EMG8500/EMG7500 before firmware v9.7.0.1, and all firmware versions of SLB882/SLCx-03/SLCx-02 contain a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with the services permission to execute arbitrary shell commands as root by exploiting the set nfs download command that passes unsanitized user input to a system() call. Attackers with the services permission can authenticate to the terminal or CLI interface and inject malicious commands through the unsanitized parameter to achieve complete loss of confidentiality, integrity, and availability on the affected device and potentially impact downstream serial-attached devices.

Lantronix SLC8000 before firmware v9.7.0.3, SLC9000 before firmware v9.7.0.2, EMG8500/EMG7500 before firmware v9.7.0.1, and all firmware versions of SLB882/SLCx-03/SLCx-02 contain a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with the services permission to execute arbitrary shell commands as root by exploiting the set script schedule command that passes unsanitized user input to a system() call. Attackers with the services permission can authenticate to the terminal or CLI interface and inject malicious commands through the unsanitized parameter to achieve complete loss of confidentiality, integrity, and availability on the affected device and potentially impact downstream serial-attached devices.

Lantronix SLC8000 before firmware v9.7.0.5, SLC9000 before firmware v9.7.0.2, EMG8500/EMG7500 before firmware v9.7.0.1, and all firmware versions of SLB882/SLCx-03/SLCx-02 contain a path traversal vulnerability in the web management portal upload endpoint that allows authenticated attackers to write arbitrary data to any location on the device's filesystem, leading to remote code execution. The upload filename validation strips backslash characters but does not subsequently check for forward slashes when a backslash is detected; by supplying a filename containing both characters an attacker writes outside the intended upload directory to any writable path. Attackers can use this vulnerability to achieve complete loss of confidentiality, integrity, and availability on the affected device and potentially impact downstream serial-connected devices.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Hossni Mubarak Books Gallery wp-books-gallery allows Blind SQL Injection.This issue affects Books Gallery: from n/a through 4.8.3.
IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information due to improper validation of endpoint URLs.

IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information due to server-side request forgery. The affected component can be made to send requests to unintended destinations and return the response to the attacker.

IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information and modify API configurations due to improper authentication. Identity information supplied in requests is not sufficiently verified, which could allow a caller to impersonate another user.
Missing authentication in Ivanti Cloud Services Application version 5.0.8 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to add and delete arbitrary trusted EPM Core certificate entries.

A incorrect authorization vulnerability in Fortinet FortiMail 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiMail 7.6.0 through 7.6.6, FortiMail 7.4.0 through 7.4.8, FortiMail 7.2 all versions may allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to obtain an authenticated IBE webmail session as any IBE recipient and read or send their encrypted mail via crafted HTTP requests.

Out-of-bounds Read vulnerability in the Guththila XML parser wrapper of Apache Axis2/C. On some malformed XML input the Guththila parser returned a raw input byte in place of an event code, and the AXIOM reader wrapper used that value as an index into a ten-entry lookup table without checking its range, reading heap memory past the end of the table. An unauthenticated client could trigger this by sending a crafted XML request to a server built with Guththila, the default parser, causing the request to be parsed incorrectly or, in some cases, the process to crash. The memory read is not returned to the client. This issue affects Apache Axis2/C: through 2.0.0. The fix is available in commits 23110287924e79d05a5b4712298c355d1f05c606 and f01683ec10e8fddb87279ec9351b3239021223e6 and will be included in the next release.

Zohocorp ManageEngine DDI Central versions below 6301 is affected by an authentication bypass vulnerability in Windows DNS and DHCP agent synchronization APIs, allowing unauthenticated user to impersonate onboarded Windows servers and perform unauthorized DNS and DHCP modifications.

Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a file upload vulnerability in the theme installer validFile() function that uses strpos() instead of strict path matching. Attackers with admin credentials can upload a ZIP containing a PHP file whose path includes /theme.php to achieve remote code execution on nginx deployments.

Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. An authenticated user with limited privileges could potentially exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to privilege escalation to root on the appliance.

A vulnerability was detected in TRENDnet TEW-657BRM 1.00.1. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /usr/sbin/upgrade_flash.cgi. Performing a manipulation of the argument boundary results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor explains: ""I am not able to confirm if such vulnerability exists as the product has been EOL for more than 15 years. We will send out an announcement letting customers know."

A vulnerability has been found in DrayTek Vigor2960 1.5.1.6. This vulnerability affects the function set_table of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi. Such manipulation of the argument jsondata leads to command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 is able to resolve this issue. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."
In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI mishandles nameArg and userid bounds checking, possibly leading to arbitrary code execution via crafted messages.

In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI relies on a world-writable /tmp file unless XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is set, or localhost TCP port 10010, allowing RXAPI communication by any local user, e.g., for injection of a macro that will be executed by a REXX script.

Rootways Authorize.net CIM Pro extension for Magento 2 before 4.1.5 contains an unauthenticated server-side request forgery vulnerability in the Apple Pay merchant validation controller. Attackers can supply file://, gopher://, or dict:// URLs in the validationUrl parameter to read app/etc/env.php credentials and encryption keys or reach internal services and cloud metadata endpoints.

SmarterTools SmarterMail Insufficient Entropy Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of SmarterTools SmarterMail. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the generation of Application Passwords. The issue results from using insufficient entropy in the generation of credentials. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-33568.

Bazarr is a companion application to Sonarr and Radarr. Prior to 1.6.3-beta.11, the /api/subtitles/subtitles-info handler uses SubtitleNameContents.get() in subtitles_contents.py and reads the caller-supplied subtitlePath after checking only its subtitle extension; because the resolved path is not confined to files indexed by Bazarr, traversal can read files outside the media library. The /api/subtitles/subtitles handler in subtitles.py passes caller-supplied path and reference to sync and translation without per-path authorization, allowing an out-of-library reference file to be read and output to overwrite a file outside the media library. The authenticate decorator gates both endpoints when API authentication is enabled, while auth = None allows access without credentials. Both paths can affect only files that the Bazarr process can read or write. This issue is fixed in version 1.6.3-beta.11.

Todoist MCP Server provides tools that allow AI agents to access and modify a Todoist account. Prior to 10.3.3, the optional todoist-mcp-http server accepts browser-origin requests to POST /mcp without validating the Host and Origin headers or authenticating the browser caller. A malicious website can use DNS rebinding to reach the loopback listener and invoke MCP tools through StreamableHTTPServerTransport, which uses the server-held Todoist API key. This exposes Todoist account data and permits operations such as task creation, updates, completion, and deletion. The stdio transport is not browser-reachable and is not affected by this attack path. This issue is fixed in version 10.3.3.

Wavelog is web-based amateur radio logging software. Prior to 2.5, the callsign parameter accepted by POST /oqrs/search_log in application/controllers/Oqrs.php search_log() reaches application/models/Oqrs_model.php search_log(), where it is concatenated directly into a raw SQL WHERE clause without parameter binding. An unauthenticated remote attacker can use UNION-based SQL injection to read arbitrary application database records, including account data, password hashes, API keys, station credentials, reset tokens, QSO data, and station metadata. Disclosure of password reset tokens can be combined with the forgot_password workflow to take over accounts, including administrator accounts. This issue is fixed in version 2.5.

Twig versions 2.16.x and 3.9.0 through 3.25.x contain a sandbox bypass vulnerability when using a SourcePolicyInterface that allows attackers with template rendering capabilities to pass arbitrary PHP callables to sort, filter, map, and reduce filters. Attackers can exploit the runtime check that fails to use the current template source to bypass sandbox restrictions and execute arbitrary code when the sandbox is enabled through a source policy rather than globally.

 This vulnerability is associated with program files scripts/EasyTimeline.Pl, includes/Timeline.Php.

SPIP before 4.4.18 contains a code injection vulnerability in SQLite-backed installations. The navigation menu endpoint improperly handles array-typed user input, which bypasses input sanitization and allows the value to break out of an internal quoted string context when evaluated as PHP. An authenticated attacker with at minimum editor (redacteur) privileges can submit a single crafted GET request to /ecrire/?exec=navigation to execute arbitrary OS commands in the web server process. MySQL-backed installations are not affected.

An improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in extract domain in Synology Chat Server before 2.4.5-22148 allows remote authenticated users, via a UI interaction, to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks in DSM.

Open Access Management (OpenAM) is an access management solution. Prior to 16.1.1, the anonymous Push Notification SNS callback handled by SnsMessageResource falls back to a CTS predicate blob after a messageId expires from the in-memory dispatcher, treats top-level blob keys as Java class names for Class.forName, and deserializes attacker-controlled JSON through Jackson. A low-privileged user who starts Push Registration and obtains the messageId, shared secret, and challenge can wait for expiry, replace the persistent blob through anonymous callbacks, and trigger class loading and construction in the OpenAM JVM. The primitive can cause classpath-dependent process execution, file writes, or denial of service, although command execution was not confirmed on the tested stock classpath. This issue is fixed in version 16.1.1.

Open Access Management (OpenAM) is an access management solution. Prior to 16.1.1, OAuthTokenStore reads caller-supplied token identifiers from the shared Core Token Store (CTS) without an OAuth-only namespace, and OAuthAdapter accepts a row whose BLOB claims to contain an OAuth token without binding the trusted CTS type or verifying integrity. An attacker who can place controlled JSON in CTS under a known token identifier, such as through Push Registration followed by an anonymous SNS callback in an enabled realm, can mint OAuth bearer tokens and OpenID Connect ID tokens with chosen subject, client, realm, and scope. The flaw does not by itself create an OpenAM SSO session or grant console access. This issue is fixed in version 16.1.1.

Open Access Management (OpenAM) is an access management solution. Prior to 16.1.1, the private_key_jwt client authentication path uses ClientJwksResolverCache without reliably binding a cached jwks_uri resolver and verified assertion to the expected clientID in ClientCredentialsReader. An attacker controlling any registered client with published keys, including one obtained through open dynamic registration when enabled, can authenticate as another client whose keys are exposed through jwks_uri and mint tokens in that client's name across realms in the same OpenAM process. This issue is fixed in version 16.1.1.

A flaw was found in the SAML HTTP-Redirect binding implementation of Keycloak. The issue occurs because the server processes percent-encoded parameter names (like %53AMLResponse) while the signature verification logic only checks literal parameter names. An attacker can use this discrepancy to provide a crafted, unsigned SAML message that the server processes instead of a legitimately signed one, leading to full account takeover of federated users.

IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code due to path traversal. File paths in uploaded content are not sufficiently validated, which could allow files to be written outside the intended location and code to be executed.
IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to broken object-level authorization.
IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to access or delete resources belonging to other tenants due to path traversal.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the RingCentral RCFaxClient disposeDocument() method of oe-module-faxsms that allows authenticated attackers to read and write arbitrary files via the file_path parameter. Attackers can use action=download to read credentials and source code, or action=setup with base64 content to write web-executable files for code execution.

A negative MicroProfile JWT clock skew setting is not rejected and disables validation of the token expiration and other time-based claims. In such configurations, an attacker in possession of an expired token can still authenticate with it. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

The development-time LiveReload support listens on all network interfaces without authentication and accepts websocket connections from any origin. A network attacker, or a web page visited by the developer, can observe the names of changed files in the watched folder and the server version, and reach the deployed applications through the additional port. This only affects LiveReload enabled in the embedded Maven plugin. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

The embedded server generates HTTP session identifiers with a non-cryptographic random number generator by default. A remote attacker who observes a session identifier can predict the identifiers issued to other users and hijack their sessions, if the application relies on HTTP sessions for authentication. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

The Jakarta Security OpenID Connect authentication mechanism generates the state and nonce values with a non-cryptographic random number generator and insufficient entropy. A remote attacker who predicts these values can forge an authentication callback that logs a victim into the attacker's account, and the replay protection for ID tokens is weakened. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

The Jakarta Security LDAP identity store accepts an empty password as valid if the directory server allows unauthenticated binds, which some directory servers do by default. A remote attacker can then authenticate as any existing user without knowing the password. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

Apache TomEE running on JDK 21 or later skips EJB method authorization checks, allowing callers to invoke EJB methods without the configured access restrictions being enforced. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

The embedded Derby network service ignores its configured bind address and listens on all network interfaces. When the service is enabled, a remote attacker with network access can connect to the database server and read or modify data. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

When Hessian remoting endpoints are served by the embedded HTTP server, configured authentication and transport security requirements are silently ignored. A remote unauthenticated attacker can invoke the exposed EJB methods without credentials or over an unencrypted connection. Only deployments that use the embedded HTTP server rather than Tomcat and rely on these settings are affected. Users are recommended to block network access to Hessian endpoints from untrusted clients, or to migrate to another remoting protocol.

When Hessian remoting is configured with BASIC authentication, the authentication check is not applied to Hessian endpoints of applications deployed under a non-root context path. A remote unauthenticated attacker can invoke the exposed EJB methods without credentials. Users are recommended to block network access to Hessian endpoints from untrusted clients, or to migrate to another remoting protocol.

When using GCC, building a malicious package that uses cgo could cause arbitrary command execution at link time via untrusted GCC spec files ("specs" or "*.spec"). When linking with "-fopenmp", "-fopenacc", or "-fsanitize=" in "#cgo LDFLAGS", GCC's built-in link spec evaluates "%:include(libgomp.spec)" or "%:include(libsanitizer.spec)" and searches for spec files in "-L" and sysroot directories (including subdirectories and multilib sibling directories such as "../lib64"), as well as the working directory when "-fopenmp" or "-fopenacc" is used or when "-fsanitize=" is combined with "-static" or "-static-lib*". The go command now rejects "-L", "-isysroot", and "-Wl,-syslibroot" directories (and the working and package directories when applicable) that contain GCC spec files, and disallows "@" and "-" prefixes in "-fsanitize=" compiler flag values.

Building a malicious package that uses cgo could cause arbitrary code execution at link time by passing linker script files to the host linker via "#cgo LDFLAGS". Split "-Wl," flags that consume a following argument (such as "-Wl,-rpath", "-Wl,--just-symbols", and "-Wl,-undefined") previously accepted a bare second argument without a "-Wl," prefix, which the compiler driver passes directly to the linker as a positional input file. Additionally, when using GNU ld.bfd, flags such as "-framework", "-Wl,-framework", "-Wl,-undefined", "-Wl,--just-symbols", "-Wl,-R", "-Wl,-subsystem", and (on non-Darwin platforms) "-Wl,-sectcreate" could cause ld.bfd to interpret their arguments as linker scripts if they named a regular file on disk. The go command now requires a "-Wl," prefix on the second token of split "-Wl," flags (except "-Wl,-R"), verifies that these flags do not reference linker script files, and disallows bare "-Wl,--warn-backrefs-exclude".

A improper authentication vulnerability in Fortinet FortiMail 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiMail 7.6.0 through 7.6.6, FortiMail 7.4.0 through 7.4.8, FortiMail 7.2 all versions may allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain access to other users' secure email accounts via crafted HTTP requests.

A use of hard-coded password vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAuthenticator 8.0.0 through 8.0.3, FortiAuthenticator 6.6.0 through 6.6.10 may allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass credential validation in certain circumstances outside of the attacker's control and gain unauthorized access.

An authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability in the SSOAuth in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.3.2-86009-5 and 7.4.1-90080-1 allows remote authenticated users to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks.

An improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory vulnerability in the Sharing API in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.3.2-86009-5 and 7.4.1-90080-1 allows remote authenticated users to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks.

A missing critical step in authentication vulnerability in the Auth API in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.3.2-86009-5 and 7.4.1-90080-1 allows remote authenticated users to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks.
Zohocorp ManageEngine DDI Central versions below 6301 is affected by a PowerShell injection vulnerability due to insufficient validation of user-supplied TXT record values in Windows DNS operations.

Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a remote code execution vulnerability allowing restricted site_admin roles to inject PHP by saving .sql files through the admin code editor. Attackers can bypass extension and content deny-lists with an @IF macro payload that compiles into executable PHP when the model loads, running OS commands as the web user.

OpenMage Magento LTS before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the admin and storefront OAuth confirm and confirmSimple actions, which accept GET requests without form-key validation. Attackers holding OAuth consumer credentials can lure a logged-in administrator or customer to a crafted confirm URL that authorizes the attacker's request token, then exchange it at /oauth/token for a persistent REST API access token bound to the victim.

OS command injection (CWE-78) in the network-configuration handling of the management service (uavmonitor_usbv1) of the 1300 communications board in DJI AeroScope Mobile (TP703) firmware 03.00.00.26, with 1300 communications board firmware 02.00.07.12 through 02.00.08.40, allows an unauthenticated attacker on the local network to execute arbitrary commands as root. Configuration values that can be written without authentication over the management interface are inserted unquoted into shell commands. Exploitation requires network access to TCP port 16000 on the board and that the unit is not connected to another controlling host. The injected command persists across reboots. Confirmed on a physical device.



NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. DJI has discontinued AeroScope Mobile and no fixed firmware is available.

The Chargely Free Subscriptions For Woocommernce WordPress plugin through 1.0 does not perform any authorization check on a REST API route that returns its stored configuration, allowing unauthenticated attackers to retrieve the live WooCommerce REST API consumer key and secret it holds, which grant read and write access to the whole store.

JSON::XS versions before 4.05 for Perl leak the decoded key of an object rejected for a missing colon in decode_hv.

Unless it is short plain ASCII, a quoted key is decoded into a new scalar. Nothing frees that scalar when the object is rejected for a missing ':' after the key.

A process that keeps running after a failed decode retains one key per rejected document, with its size chosen by the sender. Repeated requests exhaust process memory.

JSON::XS versions from 4.0_00 before 4.05 for Perl corrupt the incremental buffer length by chopping past its end in incr_skip after a top-level number.

The incremental parser scans any run of digits, signs, dots and exponent markers as one number, but the decoder stops at the end of a valid number, so the parser keeps an offset into bytes it has not decoded. It then empties the buffer without clearing those bytes, and a later incr_parse call without new input reads them again and moves the offset past the end of the buffer. incr_skip, the documented recovery after an error, removes that many bytes and the buffer length wraps.

A peer sending input such as "1-2" to an incr_parse consumer can make the next read of incr_text exit the process through perl's uncatchable out-of-memory path.

JSON::XS versions from 3.0 before 4.05 for Perl read freed stack memory when a FREEZE result's serialisation grows the Perl stack under allow_tags in encode_rv.

With allow_tags, an object's FREEZE method is called in list context and each returned value is encoded through a saved Perl stack pointer. When encoding a returned value calls back into Perl, through TO_JSON under convert_blessed or another FREEZE, and that callback grows the stack, the stack is reallocated while the saved pointer still refers to the freed block.

Encoding such objects reads freed memory, and encode can return undef without an error.

A vulnerability was identified in Tenda AC18 15.03.05.05_multi/15.03.05.19 Build 6318. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /cgi-bin/upgrade of the component Firmware Upgrade Handler. Such manipulation of the argument upgradeFile leads to insufficient verification of data authenticity. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

Cyrus SASL through 2.1.28 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the SRP server mechanism because srp_server_mech_step2 does not reject client public values A that are multiples of N. Unauthenticated network clients can send A equal to N to force a zero shared secret, authenticating as any existing user without the password and learning session keys.

Tensei through 0.11.5 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in @tensei/auth that allows unauthenticated or authenticated users to assign themselves arbitrary roles via the exposed User Roles field. Attackers can supply a roles array during registration, a POST to the users route, or a PATCH to their own record to gain administrator permissions.

DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write arbitrary files by importing projects with crafted IDs. Attackers can set absolute or ../ project IDs via /api/v1/database/import, then upload ZIPs through /api/v1/scan/upload-zip following cloned symlinks to overwrite app/main.py for remote code execution.

Silverstripe Framework is a PHP framework which powers the Silverstripe CMS. From 6.0.0 until 6.2.13, the writer option of i18nTextCollectorTask is passed to the dependency injector without validating that it names an allowed writer implementation. A crafted dev task URL can therefore instantiate arbitrary objects with attacker-controlled constructor arguments and execute code on the server. An administrator can be induced to run the task by following a link because the nested task did not require confirmation, and a site in dev mode exposes the path without authentication. CMS 5 is not affected. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.13.
Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.
Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office OneNote allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

Ghost by muneeb141 on the main branch from commit c731cdf through commit 672dfec contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the whitelisted ghost.api.ghost.convert_to_real_user method that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip OTP verification by setting the client-supplied bypass_otp parameter. Attackers can obtain a ghost session from the guest-accessible create_ghost_session endpoint, then call convert_to_real_user with an arbitrary real_email and bypass_otp=1 to receive OAuth tokens for existing accounts and take them over.

Cloud Commander (cloudcmd) before 19.21.4 contains an authentication bypass and path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to rename files by sending PUT /rename requests handled before authentication middleware. Attackers can supply absolute or ../ paths in the from and to arrays to move any file the Node.js process can access outside the configured root, causing data loss or denial of service.

The order-tracking functionality in ICRTouch ByTable and TouchTakeaway does not adequately verify that a requester is authorized to access the specified order. An unauthenticated remote attacker can modify an order identifier to retrieve information associated with other customers’ orders.

The PocketTouch and TouchPoint POS protocol includes a `SAVECONFIG` command that appears capable of overwriting till configuration files remotely. 
An attacker with network access to the POS socket service may be able to submit a crafted `SAVECONFIG` command and replace or modify terminal configuration data.

The PocketTouch and TouchPoint POS `CHECKPAYMENT` workflow accepts a caller-supplied clerk number without adequately verifying that the requesting client is authorized to act as that clerk.
An attacker with access to the POS protocol may be able to specify another employee’s clerk identifier and submit payment-related requests under that identity.

The NFC authentication handshake relies on a fixed, static challenge instead of a unique, random value for every session. This allows an attacker to perform a "replay attack," successfully authenticating by simply sending the same pre-recorded response.

NVIDIA Model Optimizer for Linux and Windows contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause a deserialization of untrusted data. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, data tampering, denial of service, and information disclosure.

Teable is an AI spreadsheet for business. Prior to release.2026-07-21T11-27-40Z.2320, a registered user can supply path traversal sequences in the hash field accepted by POST /api/attachments/signature when the default local storage provider is in use. In apps/nestjs-backend/src/features/attachments/plugins/local.ts, LocalStorage.presigned uses the client-controlled hash as the storage filename, and LocalStorage.save resolves that path and copies the uploaded request body without calling assertPathWithinStorage on the write path. The read path uses the jail, but the write path does not, allowing the resolved destination to escape the configured storage directory. Because the backend container runs as uid 0, the attacker can write or overwrite arbitrary root-owned files, which can corrupt the instance or lead to root code execution. Object-storage deployments that do not use LocalStorage.save are not affected by this sink. This issue is fixed in release.2026-07-21T11-27-40Z.2320.

Dolibarr ERP CRM through 24.0.3 contains a code injection vulnerability in Website::importWebSite() that allows website editors without PHP permission to execute code by importing templates. Attackers can import a template zip whose javascript.js.php contains PHP code, which the public javascript.js.php endpoint includes, executing code as the web server user.

Pi-hole FTL is the core engine of the Pi-hole network-level advertisement and tracker blocker. From 6.0 until 6.7, check_client_auth() in src/api/auth.c detects that a matching session identifier has passed valid_until but still assigns user_id before the expired state can be rejected. That assignment sends execution through the authorized branch, renews valid_until for another timeout interval, and leaves the session-expired response unreachable. An attacker who possesses a previously valid session identifier can periodically reuse it to preserve administrative access indefinitely, making the configured session timeout ineffective. This issue is fixed in version 6.7.

open62541 Subscription Use-After-Free Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of open62541. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of subscriptions. The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-30231.

SmarterTools SmarterMail Missing Authorization Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of SmarterTools SmarterMail. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the svcDomainAdmin.asmx endpoint. The issue results from the lack of authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges to resources normally protected from the user. Was ZDI-CAN-33566.

SmarterTools SmarterMail File Edit API Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of SmarterTools SmarterMail. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the FileStorageController class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-30742.

ILIAS before 9.25, 10.13, and 11.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in ilPRGAssignmentFilter::toConditions() that allows authenticated users to inject SQL through the StudyProgramme members list Name and Status filters. Attackers holding only the OrgUnit permission to view members can break out of LIKE literals and execute stacked statements, such as overwriting the root password hash to gain administrative control.

Netgate pfSense CE XMLRPC Incorrect Authorization Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Netgate pfSense. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the XMLRPC endpoint. The issue results from incorrect authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code within the context of the root. Was ZDI-CAN-32353.

The Essential Real Estate plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 5.3.3 via deserialization of untrusted input in the 'saved_search_check_result' function. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to inject a PHP Object. No known POP chain is present in the vulnerable software, which means this vulnerability has no impact unless another plugin or theme containing a POP chain is installed on the site. If a POP chain is present via an additional plugin or theme installed on the target system, it may allow the attacker to perform actions like delete arbitrary files, retrieve sensitive data, or execute code depending on the POP chain present.

Zohocorp Manageengine DDI Central build below 6500 are affected by a authenticated PowerShell command injection vulnerability in the Telnet connectivity feature, allowing specially crafted IPv6 scope identifiers to execute arbitrary commands on managed Windows nodes.

Zohocorp Manageengine DDI Central build below 6500 are affected by a authenticated command injection vulnerability in the Windows DDI Agent's clear_blocked_domains functionality, allowing specially crafted blocked-domain values to trigger arbitrary command execution on Windows systems.
Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. Exploitation could lead to arbitrary command execution with root privileges on the appliance.

WWBN AVideo through c3edcc274c389816d434acadac07ee78eaf330c1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability because the default node socket server relays autoEvalCodeOnHTML without the PHP-only filter. Unauthenticated attackers can obtain an anonymous socket token and send a spoofed MSG_BATCH message to trigger client eval() in administrators' browsers for account takeover.

SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to execute script by storing malicious Attribute View column names rendered unescaped in col.ts. Attackers can inject HTML via addAttributeViewKey, .sy.zip import, or sync, and when a victim adds or duplicates the column, insertAdjacentHTML runs JavaScript with Node.js privileges for desktop code execution.

SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in genAVValueHTML() that allows attackers who can store Attribute View asset values to inject script through an unescaped image src attribute. Attackers can store an image URL containing a double quote and onerror handler that executes OS commands via Node.js in the desktop app when victims open the bound note or row attribute panel.

SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability, an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-44670, because renderAVAttribute() inserts an Attribute View name unescaped into the database row attribute panel header. Attackers who can persist the name, such as via the setAttrViewName action, can inject an onerror handler that runs OS commands through Node.js when a desktop user opens the panel.

NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator or Owner users to inject raw SQL by persisting a crafted formula parsed_tree reused without revalidation. Attackers can bypass the SQLite metadata path guard with an alias to plant the tree, escalating to super administrator or executing OS commands on external PostgreSQL hosts.

The ownCloud Desktop Client synchronizes files between an ownCloud server and a desktop. Prior to 6.0.2, an authenticated attacker can share a specially crafted file with a victim. If the file is synced by the client and revealed in the macOS Finder, it can cause operating-system command injection on the victim’s computer. This issue is fixed in version 6.0.2.

Zyrabit Platform provides sovereign AI infrastructure for enterprise retrieval-augmented generation. Prior to 2.4.4, import_to_vault(source_path, destination_name) accepts both caller-controlled paths, but the content-pattern guard does not confine destination_name. The vulnerable tool is implemented in zyrabit-slm/api-rag/app/domain/services/mcp_service.py, where Path(DOCS_DIR) / destination_name is passed to shutil.copy2, allowing traversal or an absolute destination to write outside the vault. An unrestricted source_path can be copied into the vault and retrieved through secure_query, disclosing files readable by the service; files that do not match the executable-pattern filter pass that filter. When ENABLE_LEGACY_EXTENSIONS=true, zyrabit-slm/api-rag/app/main.py registers POST /mcp/rpc without get_current_user, allowing unauthenticated network tool calls; this optional exposure is disabled by default and is not required for local invocation. If an attacker can stage chosen source content and write to an execution-triggered destination, the advisory describes conditional process execution. This issue is fixed in version 2.4.4.

Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 1.11.40 and 2.0.3, src/Chamilo/CourseBundle/Component/CourseCopy/CourseRestorer.php and src/CourseBundle/Component/CourseCopy/CourseRestorer.php use paths supplied by an imported legacy course backup without consistently confining them to the extraction directory. A course teacher can import a crafted backup containing parent-directory path segments, causing file operations to write attacker-controlled content outside the intended destination, including PHP-executable or automatically loaded locations. This can result in code execution as the PHP process and compromise course data, user data, credentials, and the host. This issue is fixed in versions 1.11.40 and 2.0.3.

A flaw has been found in DrayTek Vigor2960 up to 1.5.1.6. This affects the function dataflowstatus of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi of the component CGI Process. This manipulation of the argument option causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 is able to mitigate this issue. You should upgrade the affected component. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

An unauthenticated OS command injection vulnerability exists in the Shenzhen Aitemi M300 Wi-Fi Repeater (hardware model MT02) via the 'time' parameter of the '/protocol.csp?' endpoint. The input is processed by the internal date '-s' command without rebooting or disrupting HTTP service. Unlike other injection points, this vector allows remote compromise without triggering visible configuration changes.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/amdgpu/vce1: Fix VCE 1 firmware size and offsets

The VCPU BO contains the actual FW at an offset, but
it was not calculated into the VCPU BO size.
Subtract this from the FW size to make sure there is
no out of bounds access.

Make sure the stack and data offsets are aligned to
the 32K TLB size.

Check that the FW microcode actually fits in the
space that is reserved for it.

(cherry picked from commit c16fe59f622a080fc457a57b3e8f14c780699449)

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

KVM: arm64: nv: Fix SPSR_EL2 restore in kvm_hyp_handle_mops()

kvm_hyp_handle_mops() resets the single-step state machine as part of
rewinding state for a MOPS exception by modifying vcpu_cpsr() and
writing the result directly into hardware.

In the case of nested virtualization, vcpu_cpsr() is a synthetic value
such that the rest of KVM can deal with vEL2 cleanly. That means the
value requires translation before being written into hardware, which is
unfortunately missing from the MOPS handler.

Fix it by directly modifying SPSR_EL2 and avoiding the synthetic state
altogether, which will be resynchronized on the next 'full' exit back
to KVM.

A flaw was found in Submariner. This vulnerability allows a malicious cluster (spoke) to redirect network traffic from other connected clusters (peer clusters) by publishing a specially crafted network endpoint. The system fails to properly validate the network subnets provided by the malicious cluster, enabling it to declare arbitrary network ranges. Consequently, all network traffic intended for these arbitrary ranges from peer clusters will be rerouted through the attacker's tunnel, potentially leading to unauthorized information disclosure or network disruption.

Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Contract Lifecycle Management for Public Sector. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 8.8 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

Lantronix SLC8000 before firmware v9.7.0.3, SLC9000 before firmware v9.7.0.2, EMG8500/EMG7500 before firmware v9.7.0.1, and all firmware versions of SLB882 contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the WebSSH/WebTelnet listener that allows unauthenticated attackers to cause the affected device to establish SSH connections to attacker-controlled endpoints. The custom shellinaboxd builds its SSH connection target using a snprintf call with user-supplied input; by supplying an overlong username string an attacker causes the device IP suffix to be truncated, redirecting the resulting connection to an arbitrary host. Attackers can use this capability to enumerate or communicate with internal network endpoints that would otherwise be inaccessible.

Lantronix SLC8000 before firmware v9.7.0.3, SLC9000 before firmware v9.7.0.2, EMG8500/EMG7500 before firmware v9.7.0.1, and all firmware versions of SLB882 contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the WebSSH/WebTelnet listener that allows unauthenticated attackers to cause the affected device to establish SSH connections to attacker-controlled endpoints. The custom shellinaboxd uses the rooturl parameter from the web connection to determine its own IP address; by modifying this parameter an attacker redirects the SSH terminal connection to an arbitrary host or IP. Attackers can use this capability to enumerate or communicate with internal network endpoints that would otherwise be inaccessible.

A flaw was found in ansible-core. When installing a collection with `ansible-galaxy collection install`, the archive extractor validates member paths using lexical path normalisation (os.path.abspath) instead of resolving symbolic links (os.path.realpath), and it performs no containment check on symlink-typed directory members before creating them. A crafted collection tarball can chain symlink directory entries so that a subsequent file member is written outside the intended destination directory. This allows an attacker who can get a victim to install a malicious collection to overwrite arbitrary files with the privileges of the user running ansible-galaxy, leading to code execution on the control node. This is a bypass of the fix for CVE-2020-10691.

virtualenv is a tool for creating isolated virtual python environments. Prior to 21.14.9, PipInvoke.get_pip_install_cmd() handles --seeder pip --download by calling get_wheel(download=False) and then allowing pip to consult the configured index, bypassing virtualenv's download_wheel() and verify_wheel_digest() path. When virtualenv's default-index PyPI digest comparison remains enabled, an index candidate matching the bundled package and version can therefore be selected without comparison to PyPI SHA-256 metadata. Explicit custom-index settings already opt out of that comparison and remain outside this verification-bypass claim; the demonstrated configuration used a non-PyPI index while leaving the index environment variables unset so the comparison policy remained active. This condition does not independently defeat TLS or establish control of the index response. This issue is fixed in version 21.14.9.

A wide range of Harbor versions allow SSRF via its webhook delivery component which does not properly validate web hook target addresses, allowing usage of private and link-local IP ranges. An authenticated attacker with ProjectAdmin permissions can configure a webhook policy pointing to a private internal address. When a project event fires, Harbor jobservice makes unauthenticated outbound HTTP POST requests to the target. If the target answers with an error status, the response body is written to the webhook execution log, which project members can read, potentially exposing cloud metadata or other network-restricted resources.

The LeRobot library is vulnerable to arbitrary code execution via unsafe dynamic class instantiation in the from_pretrained() method and related paths. When loading a policy's processor configuration from a repository,  the library uses the class field within the JSON configuration to dynamically resolve and instantiate Python classes using importlib.import_module() and getattr().

A flaw was found in the Trainer v2 TrainJob API. A user with permissions to create TrainJobs can exploit this by injecting `valueFrom.secretKeyRef` into environment variable definitions. This allows them to read and exfiltrate sensitive information (secrets) from the namespace, leading to a privilege escalation. This occurs when the TrainJob Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) is broader than the Secret read RBAC.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to delete arbitrary patient recall records via the delete_Recall action. Attackers can send POST requests to /interface/main/messages/save.php with a target pid and r_ID to remove recall data without ACL or ownership checks.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to read cross-patient FHIR QuestionnaireResponse data by sending the APICSRFTOKEN header. Attackers can reuse the session-exposed api_csrf_token_js value to skip FHIR scope checks and call GET /fhir/QuestionnaireResponse, exfiltrating site-wide questionnaire answer PHI.

OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in portal onsite-document APIs that allows any authenticated core user to access cross-patient documents. Attackers can omit the patientId parameter and supply arbitrary record IDs to list, read, and overwrite other patients' portal documents, signatures, and template data.

OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the classic document controller that allows low-privilege authenticated users to recategorize other patients' documents. Attackers can invoke move_action_process to move a document into a patients|demo category, then retrieve it with an empty patient_id to exfiltrate PHI and tamper with charts.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.
